🌸 A Word of Gratitude to Ms. Doris Yin & the GCV Global Leadership Team 🌸

On behalf of GCV Vietnam, we would like to express our deepest and most sincere gratitude to Ms. Doris Yin - Founder, the guiding light of the GCV Global Movement, and the entire GCV International Leadership Team.
Her inspiring sharing and recognition are not only a great source of encouragement for the GCV Vietnam team, but also a strong motivation to urge us to continue to commit, act and dedicate ourselves to the common mission.
Each word of encouragement from her is a reminder that:
✨ GCV is not just a movement, but a historic journey to create true value for the pioneering community and for all humanity.
✨ GCV not only connects businesses, but also connects the hearts, beliefs and aspirations of millions of people around the world.
We are extremely proud to be a part of the global GCV family under the wise, loving and far-sighted leadership of Ms. Doris and the Board of Directors. It is her dedication and silent sacrifice that has lit the fire of belief, so that from Vietnam to the Philippines, Indonesia, China, Thailand, Palestine, Burundi... we are all sharing the same heartbeat, the same aspiration to create a new era for Pi and GCV. 
We would like to thank Ms. Doris Yin and the Global Board of Directors for always following, accompanying and supporting us on this journey. 
🇻🇳 GCV Vietnam promises to continue to maintain the pioneering spirit, take practical actions, and spread GCV values ​​to every business, every family, every person in the community. 
With all our gratitude! 
Dao Duc Viet
Chief Ambassador of GCV Vietnam
Special Envoy - Chairman of the Vietnam GCV Industry Alliance 🇻🇳 @dorisyincpa

quoted_tweet.text:
**GCV Vietnam Leads the Way with Inspiring Progress! 🇻🇳**

I highly recommend that all pioneers check out the GCV Vietnam YouTube channel, where the team consistently shares important updates and community news.

What stands out the most is the seriousness, professionalism, and hard work of the GCV Vietnam Core Team. Their dedication sets a great example for all of us.

After announcing the deployment of the Industry Alliance, Mr. Việt, the Head of Vietnam GCV Ambassador and GCV Industry Alliance Vietnam Special Envoy Chair, and his team took immediate action. They successfully signed Nam Binh Rice as a GCV Industry Alliance member, agreeing to support 30% Pi payments at GCV value. Additionally, they traveled 1,000 kilometers to personally connect with multiple businesses across Vietnam to invite them into the Industry Alliance.

This level of diligence and commitment truly inspired me. It reminds me of the saying:

> “Nothing is difficult in the world if you set your mind to it.”

Vietnam is not alone in this effort. Around the world, pioneers are moving forward with the same determination.

GCV Philippines, GCV Indonesia, GCV China, and GCV Thailand have already begun their own Industry Alliance initiatives.

GCV Palestine and GCV Burundi are also preparing to establish their own alliances.

These actions are more than just symbolic; they create real value for businesses, pioneers, and the Pi Network ecosystem.

I sincerely hope to see more GCV YouTube channels led by Ambassadors in different regions, following the inspiring example set by GCV Vietnam.

👉 Watch GCV Vietnam’s YouTube update here: GCV Vietnam YouTube Channel
https://t.co/MNTQ1GHbrS

Together, we are demonstrating the power of pioneers united under GCV!

Doris Yin 🪷 🪷🪷  
Founder, Global GCV Movement  
August 27th, 2025
